_comment_bjj: How a session is recognised as BJJ. An activity counts if its Garmin typeKey is in bjj_type_keys, OR its name matches one of bjj_name_patterns (case-insensitive substring). Adjust after the first sync once you see the real type keys in data/activity_types.json.
_comment_targets: Goals the dashboard measures you against.
_comment_hygiene: Sessions shorter than this are ignored (accidental starts, forgotten stops are capped).
_comment_budgets: Per-run request budgets, to stay well under Garmin rate limits. Backfill catches up over several daily runs.
